notes: Cards remember their story now: the lineage foundation. Every card gains three fields Stasys maintains itself. 'Created' is stamped the day a card is born, and 'last touched' is re-stamped whenever the card's content actually changes - dragging it around the board does not count, and neither date can be typed by hand, which is what makes them trustworthy. Cards can also carry typed links to each other - blocks, derives-from, part-of - written through Claude's door, where a bad link (a missing card, an unknown type, a duplicate) is refused with a message naming exactly which entry is wrong. Older copies of Stasys cannot wipe any of this: a save from a version that does not know these fields preserves them instead of dropping them. Cards from before this version honestly show no birth date - that history was never recorded anywhere, and an invented date would be worse than a blank. Nothing is visible on the board yet, on purpose: this is the data layer the next versions draw from - card signals (ages, blocked and next markers), the thread map, and the lineage timeline. DEFERRED.md already lists each card's links.
